subject: Mythology
title: Nike, Amazon, and Mythological Brands
description: A micro-lesson that makes Nike, Amazon, and Mythological Brands usable.

hook.text: Nike is the Greek goddess of victory. You wear her name on your shoes every time you go running.

buildup.text: Amazon is named after the warrior women of Greek myth. Hermes delivers packages in Europe. Mythology sells products.

discovery.text: Trident gum, Venus razors, Oracle software, and Pandora music all borrow mythological names to sound powerful.

twist.text: These brands chose myths on purpose. Mythology gives instant meaning — strength, speed, wisdom — without explanation.

climax.text: Companies spend billions on branding, but a free mythological name does the job better than any advertising campaign.

punchline.text: The gods work harder now as brand names than they ever did on Mount Olympus.

quiz.question: Why do companies choose mythological names for their brands?
options: Mythological names are not copyrighted so they are free to use
Mythology gives instant meaning like strength, speed, or wisdom without needing explanation
Market research shows customers prefer Greek and Roman words
